comments.body:
Thanks for this. #833 fixes the same bug (the second half of #821) with the same change to `_tokenize_and_escape_query`: normalise the token, check stopwords and weights against it, then escape. It has already been reviewed and approved, so we'll take that one and close this as a duplicate.

One point in case it's useful elsewhere: the Release Notes say weights on words with punctuation are now applied, but they don't change ranking. Redis splits indexed text on punctuation, so `state-of-the-art` is stored as `state`, `of`, `the` and `art`, and the escaped query term `state\-of\-the\-art` matches no documents. On Redis 8.2 and 8.10, `~@body:(state\-of\-the\-art=>{$weight:3} | search)` returns exactly the same scores as `~@body:(search)`.
